name: RemoveListenerCertificate
label: Remove AWS ELB Listener Certificate
description: Removes a certificate from an AWS Elastic Load Balancer (ALB/NLB) listener.

fields.name: AWSServiceVaultId
fields.label: Credential to connect with
fields.description: Select the AWS credential to use for authentication (AWSServiceVaultId).

fields.name: CertificateArn
fields.label: Certificate ARN
fields.description: The ARN of the ACM certificate to remove from the listener.

fields.name: Region
fields.label: AWS Region
fields.description: The AWS region where the load balancer is located (e.g., us-east-1). Default: us-east-1.

fields.name: Response
fields.label: API Response
fields.description: Raw JSON response from AWS ELB.

fields.name: Success
fields.label: Success
fields.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful.
